notes: Generated from commit 95cdfd0 for B0, B1, P1, P1-noPred and P1-noApp. The four B2 entries were re-snapshotted after the determinism fix in Phase 4: before it, B2's duplication target and backup-activation order depended on Python's per-process hash seed (set iteration over LinkId), so no single pre-Phase-4 B2 result existed. The fix pins the link-preference order, which reproduces the PYTHONHASHSEED=2 ordering of the original code. See docs/PROGRESS.md.
